name: Ember Bay
blurb: Drive the fire engine and answer every call across town!

background.css: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #E5E043 0 24px, #D8362D 24px 48px) bottom/100% 8px no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle at 84% 16%, rgba(216,54,45,.35), transparent 46%), repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,.035) 0 12px, transparent 12px 24px), linear-gradient(#1C1D1F, #111214)

source.notes: Home screen title is Archivo 900 uppercase in hi-vis #E5E043 on graphite #1C1D1F (the game also widens it with font-stretch 125%, which the card can't express). The hi-vis/engine-red Battenburg strip along the bottom and the diagonal hatching come from the home and crew screens; the red glow by the fire engine icon echoes the engine livery #D8362D.
